data.user_prompt: Кто делает сайты для экспертов в Польше на русском языке?

sections.text:

**[MediaPower](https://www.google.com/maps/search/MediaPower%2C+%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%88%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%2C+%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%88%D0%B0?utm_source=openai)**

**[Extraweb](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Extraweb%2C+%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%88%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%2C+%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%88%D0%B0?utm_source=openai)**

**[LimeAI](https://www.google.com/maps/search/LimeAI%2C+%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%88%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%2C+%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%88%D0%B0?utm_source=openai)**

**[Rush Agency](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Rush+Agency%2C+%D0%9C%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B2%D0%B0%2C+%D0%A0%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%8F?utm_source=openai)**
